question: Odacchi!! Hello!! Was the "Left Hand of the Pirate King" Scopper Gaban's name inspired by ? I used to watch it on TV when I was little. Beaver's Tooth
answer: Oh, you're from the same generation as me, haha. A lot of people have said this, but it's not correct. I love old movies, and sometimes I borrow the names of old actors. There's a famous French actor, , who's a really cool guy, and I borrowed the name from him. (Translator's note: "Gaban", "Gavan", and "Gabin" are all spelled the same in Japanese. Coincidentally, despite Oda's denial of Space Sheriff Gavan as inspiration, it was also named after Jean Gabin.)
name: Broken Beaver's Tooth
